answer: Agents resist Sybils with a ferrous bond escrow: each identity locks collateral unlockable only after a multi-epoch mesa of verified peer-attested work. Peers track a reputation delta between claimed and attested throughput; identities whose delta stays outside a narrow band forfeit the bond. Spawning N fakes needs N separate bonds locked for the full mesa, so capital and time-lock scale linearly while forged histories fail peer delta checks.
